offer_terms.claim_guidance: Use 'about 50% less than monthly Pro' or show $149/mo versus $75/mo billed annually. Do not call this 50% off the standard annual price.

testing_rules.principle: Each creative must communicate the full product category, make stock signals the focal point, show a complete user outcome, and carry the Founding Pro offer.
guardrails: Keep audience, placement, bid strategy, destination and schedule identical.
Run in the same 4:5 mobile image placement.
Do not declare a winner before every creative clears the conversion floor.
Pause all offer creatives immediately if Founding Pro terms change.

creatives.hypothesis: A stock-centric promise that reveals every market force behind the signal will best communicate category breadth without feeling like a feature list.
creatives.primary_text: Don’t just trade the ticker. Trade the market behind it—with entry and risk mapped.
creatives.headline: Trade the market behind the stock.

creatives.hypothesis: A visible context-to-signal pipeline will make the complete decision workflow easiest to understand at a glance.
creatives.primary_text: Turn market noise into one ranked stock signal, entry zone and invalidation level.
creatives.headline: From market noise to one clear trade plan.

creatives.hypothesis: Contrasting basic charting with an integrated intelligence layer will position the browser Terminal against mainstream chart-only tools.
creatives.primary_text: Your chart shows what happened. Ranked stock signals explain what to watch next—and why.
creatives.headline: A browser Terminal with the intelligence layer built in.

creatives.hypothesis: Showing the evidence read before the answer will distinguish Mastermind AI from ticker-only chat tools.
creatives.primary_text: Ask about a stock. Get the signal, market context, entry and risk—not a generic answer.
creatives.headline: Get the market around the stock.

creatives.hypothesis: Proof-led explainability and a visible evidence stack will build more trust than an unqualified buy/sell promise.
creatives.primary_text: Every stock signal should show its work: regime, rotation, flow, funds, entry and risk.
creatives.headline: Signals with receipts.
